scope: Actual PostgreSQL WASM execution, local Supabase roles/storage schema stand-ins only. No external database, Storage service, provider, credentials or cloud account.
postgres: PostgreSQL 18.3 (PGlite 0.5.8) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit

tests.name: migration executes as owner, creates all functions and disabled budgets
anon/authenticated denied tables and RPC; restrictive storage policy protects only dedicated buckets
service role has only read/credit-limit mutation and public RPCs; internal helpers denied
zero budgets reject atomically; valid prepare reserves exact budgets/storage and dedupe only once
input contracts and exact immutable upload paths/hashes enforced
bounded claims, global lease slots and explicit job isolation execute
safety required, durable submission, lease/revision CAS and task immutability
both actual stage contracts complete with immutable assets; terminal release stays budget-reserved
expired submitting lease becomes uncertain and cannot become another paid attempt
uncertain job with separately known task can poll without reset/retry
two-hour retention grace, proven-unsent refund and idempotent storage purge
derived-reference generation must complete and pass matching-image moderation before Tripo
safety result wrong hash/protocol/category cannot authorize paid intent
missing/null asset fields, oversize generated totals and helper null inputs rejected
